Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using TAP tags to identify interactors of ZIKV non-structural proteins. While the text mentions SUMOylation in the context of PIAS1 and NS5 stability, this was investigated via Western Blot and GST-pulldown, not via a SUMO-remnant MS enrichment workflow. Therefore, mod_sumo_qqtgg is not applied.

scope: The interaction network was generated by combining tandem-affinity purification followed by mass spectrometry with yeast two-hybrid screens.
About 1 × 10^8 cells were used for the purification of the protein complexes using the InterPlay TAP purification kit (Stratagene) as described previously.
We then performed tandem affinity purification coupled to mass spectrometry (TAP-MS), which resulted in a high-confidence PIN
